title: Le conditionnel présent
subtitle: Would: politeness and hypotheses
review: Imported from the old tense page. Texts and examples are the old ones; the level is a guess.
intro: Used for possibility, politeness, wishes, hypothetical situations, advice, reported speech (future-in-the-past), and after *si* clauses with the imparfait.

examples.en: That could work.
What would make you happy?

examples.fr: Ça aurait été dommage de jeter ça.
examples.en: It would be a shame to throw it away.

examples.fr: Je **voudrais** un café, s’il vous plaît.
examples.en: I’d like a coffee, please.
Could you help me?
Shall we do that later?
Could you explain?

examples.fr: J'**aimerais** que tu viennes très vite, si tu pouvais.
examples.en: I would like you to come very soon, if you could.

examples.fr: Si j’**avais** le temps, je **voyagerais** plus.
examples.en: If I had time, I would travel more.

examples.fr: Si on **était** libres, on **irait** au cinéma.
examples.en: If we were free, we’d go to the movies.
If it were nice out, we’d have a picnic.
If I were you, I would be wary.
You should rest.
You might want to check that.
We could call before going.

examples.fr: Si tu as un moment, tu **pourrais** y jeter un coup d’œil.
examples.en: If you have a moment, you might take a look at it.
He said he would come around 8.
According to the forecast, it may rain tomorrow.
According to her, it would cost too much.

examples.fr: Il a dit que je **pouvais** le prendre.
examples.en: He said I could take it.

blocks.title: Formula
points: *parler* → je **parlerais**, tu parlerais, il parlerait, nous parlerions, vous parleriez, ils parleraient
blocks.note: Spelling changes match the futur simple (e.g., *manger → je mangerais*, *appeler → j’appellerais*).

blocks.title: Common irregular stems (same as futur simple)
blocks.formula:
**aur-** (avoir) → j’**aurais**  |  **ser-** (être) → je **serais**  |  **ir-** (aller) → j’**irais**  |  **fer-** (faire) → je **ferais**
**voudr-** (vouloir) → je **voudrais**  |  **pourr-** (pouvoir) → je **pourrais**  |  **devr-** (devoir) → je **devrais**
**viendr-** (venir) → je **viendrais**  |  **verr-** (voir) → je **verrais**  |  **enverr-** (envoyer) → j’**enverrais**  |  **tiendr-** (tenir) → je **tiendrais**
blocks.note: Pronunciation tip: the endings *-ais, -ait* sound like *[ɛ]* (same as imparfait).

blocks.text: si + imparfait → conditionnel présent ; *au cas où* (+ conditionnel) ; softeners: *je voudrais, je pourrais, on ferait, ça serait*.

examples.fr: Je **ne pourrais pas** venir ce soir.
examples.en: I wouldn’t be able to come tonight.
Wouldn’t you like to try?
Would you make an exception?
I will leave.
I would leave if I had a car.

examples.fr: Same stems; different endings and meaning (certainty vs. possibility).

points: Conjugate in conditionnel: *aller, pouvoir, devoir* — je/tu/il/nous/vous/ils.
Transform with *si*: *J’ai de l’argent →* Si j’*avais* de l’argent, je *voyagerais*.
Polite requests: Reformulate *Donnez-moi un café* → *Je voudrais un café*.
